values.Description:
KTNLang is a project built without AI assistance as I learnt to about building interpreters. I followed the book [Crafting Interpreters](https://craftinginterpreters.com/) for the concepts. 

KTNLang is a dynamically typed language with the following features:
- Numbers, strings, booleans, and `nil`
- Arrays
- Arithmetic operators
- Comparison and equality operators
- Unary operators
- Comma operator
- String concatenation
- Variables and assignment
- Lexical scoping and variable shadowing
- Nested blocks
- `if / else`
- Short-circuiting `and / or`
- `while` loops
- `for` loops
- `break`
- Functions with parameters
- Return values
- Recursion
- Closures
- Native functions: `clock()` and `len()`
- `_ARCH` global variable
- Array literals
- Array indexing
- Array mutation
- String indexing
- Array concatenation with `+`
- Classes and instances
- Instance fields
- Methods
- Constructors via `init`
- `this`
- Inheritance
- Method overriding
- `super`
- Static lexical resolution
- Semantic error detection
- Parser and runtime error handling
- File execution
- Interactive REPL
values.Tagline: Kompiles To Nothing Lang - My first foray into writing interpreters
values.Title: KTNLang
